mapper.select: SELECT s.*,cv.word_term FROM word_study_state s JOIN learning_content lc ON lc.id=s.content_id AND lc.state='published' JOIN content_version cv ON cv.id=lc.published_version_id AND cv.review_status='approved' WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.pending=1 AND (s.source_kind<>'review' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM review_schedule live WHERE live.id=s.schedule_id AND live.owner_id=s.owner_id AND live.state='active' AND live.due_date<=#{date})) AND (s.exposed=1 OR s.source_kind='review' OR s.free_study=1 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM daily_task allocated JOIN daily_package dp ON dp.id=allocated.package_id WHERE allocated.id=s.task_id AND allocated.status IN ('TODO','DOING') AND dp.business_date=#{date})) AND s.source_kind='review' AND (s.source_kind='review' OR s.free_study=1 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM daily_task t WHERE t.id=s.task_id AND t.status='DOING') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vocabulary_book_word w WHERE w.content_id=s.content_id AND w.book_id=#{book})) ORDER BY s.eligible_position,s.first_seen_date,s.content_id
